description: Licence policy for the published RF Swift images (penthertz/rfswiftdev_resolute, penthertz/rfswift_resolute). Read by scripts/compliance/check-license-policy.py; see docs/licensing.md. blocked_components fail the check (exit 1); review_required_components need an owner decision; notice_required_components need their notices and source kept.
image_tree_note: Image -> images built FROM it (Dockerfiles/Makefile). installed_in names the images whose Dockerfile installs a component; images also lists every image built on them. The checker warns when the two disagree.

blocked_components.name: OFRAK (Red Balloon Security)
blocked_components.licence: OFRAK Community License (academic and personal non-commercial use) or OFRAK Pro
found_in: scripts/reverse_software.sh: ofrak_soft_install, which refuses to run without OFRAK_ACCEPT_LICENSE=yes
blocked_components.reason: Never pre-installed. The repository's own notes (reverse_software.sh, reversing.docker) record that the Community License covers academic and personal non-commercial use only and does not allow redistributing OFRAK, so a published image must not carry it. It is blocked only as a guard: the entry removes nothing from today's images and fails the check if an image ever ships /opt/ofrak or the ofrak packages.
blocked_components.decision: None while it stays opt-in. Remove this entry only with a redistribution grant from Red Balloon Security.
